en: A vintage sepia-toned portrait of a woman in late 19th‑century or early 20th‑century attire, wearing an ornate dress with embroidery, medals, and long pearl necklaces. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo. At the bottom of the image, there is Russian text: the center appears to give her name, and the lower right credits a photographer associated with the Imperial Theatres. The card edges show age-related discoloration typical of old photographic postcards.
